explanation: Mathlib has `Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing` (Mathlib/RingTheory/FiniteType.lean), but reaching its `FiniteType` hypothesis from finite generation of the irrelevant ideal requires the substantive graded-algebra result `finiteType_of_irrelevant_fg` from this library.
